name: People (AI steps)
description: What the AI does with your people: reads what new messages say about them (roles, tasks, promises, links), writes their overview, tells a person from an organisation and places them in a circle, and matches the names. The contacts themselves stay Zeff's.
author: Zeff

aiTasks.label: People: what the messages say
aiTasks.what: Reads new messages for what they say about the people you keep a profile of: roles, tasks, facts, promises, links.

aiTasks.label: People: a person's overview
aiTasks.what: Writes a person's short overview from everything Zeff has on them.

aiTasks.label: People: person or organisation, circle
aiTasks.what: Places contacts: a person or an organisation, and their circle.

aiTasks.label: People: one identity per person
aiTasks.what: Matches the names in your todos, chats and mails to your profiles.
